source: A {0}YAML plugin{/0} is a data file. It covers the common cases: detection, resource patterns, translate calls, regex scanners, scopes, placeholders and extraction templates. It needs no code and no build, and an editor validates it with a JSON Schema. It works in YAML and JSON projects without Node dependencies.
text: {0}YAML 插件{/0}是一个数据文件，可以覆盖常见场景：检测、资源模式、翻译调用、正则扫描器、作用域、占位符和提取模板。它不需要代码和构建，编辑器可以通过 JSON Schema 对其进行校验。它可用于 YAML 和 JSON 项目，不依赖 Node。
